questions.subject: MySQL
questions.question: Explain the difference between EXPLAIN output and connection pooling in MySQL.
questions.ideal_answer: EXPLAIN output and connection pooling differ in several ways: EXPLAIN output is query plan analysis (works by understanding MySQL optimizer decisions) whereas connection pooling is connection reuse (works by reducing connection overhead). EXPLAIN output is typically used for type, possible_keys, key, rows, Extra columns, while connection pooling is used for max_connections, thread_cache_size, connection pool (app side). Example demonstrating EXPLAIN output: EXPLAIN FORMAT=JSON SELECT ...;. Example demonstrating connection pooling: HikariCP, c3p0, Druid.
